newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RESEARCH ALERT - Sydney Casino rated "buy".
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Sydney Casino rated "buy".

text.p: Sydney casino operator Sydney Harbour Casino Ltd was a "buy" investment, reflecting signs of an improved operating performance, Morgan Stockbroking Ltd said in a report.

The report was written before the weekend announcement that Kerry Packer's Publishing & Broadcasting Ltd had decided not to buy Showboat Inc's management contract for the casino and a 10 percent casino stake.
"Operating performance is showing signs of improvement," Morgan analysts said in their report.
Daily visitor numbers were running at 15,000 on average since the start of this year, a substantial increase on the 12,500 in November 1996, the analysts said.

Daily gaming machine revenue was also on an upward trend with much of the improvement attributed to the bus programme drawing about 3,000 new visitors to the casino each week, the Morgan analysts said.
Chief executive, Neil Gamble was also making several positive changes to the way in which the casino operated, they said.
"These changes are likely to continue to occur in the lead up to the opening of the permanent casino later this year," the Morgan report said.
Morgan said the company was expecting to pay a maiden fully-franked dividend for calendar 1997 of five cents a share from net earnings of A$52 million compared with A$46 million in calender 1996.
The group's share price at the time of the report was A$2.14 and at 0330 GMT (1.30 p.m.) on Monday, it stood at the same level.
